COD.rationale: C, O and D explicitly supported for p0/current/n0 with matching referent and time.

C.rationale: Identifies represented content (color and explicit positions) for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: Content identification (red positions) is presented separately from its organization/origin status.

O.rationale: Specifies how the content representation is organized/obtained (origin and represented_time).
